## Checklist

- [ ] Runs from a clean install with one command (`ros2 launch ...`)
- [ ] Has / updates a short recipe README
- [ ] States the exact versions tested (ROS distro, Gazebo, OS)
- [ ] Launch file accepts `headless:=true`
- [ ] Wired into CI (a matrix row in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`) if it's a new recipe
- [ ] Conventional Commit title (e.g. `feat(05-...): ...`)
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes
